'''Marcel Louis Vonk''' (born 14 January 1974) is a poker player and the first Dutch person to win a [[World Series of Poker]] (WSOP) bracelet in [[betting (poker)|No Limit]] [[Texas hold 'em|Hold'em]] (NLHE).  On 5 July 2010, he beat out 3,843 opponents to capture the gold bracelet in event #54: $1,000 No-Limit Hold'em, taking home $570,960 USD for the victory.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Schult |first=Steve |date=July 5, 2010 |title=World Series of Poker -- Marcel Vonk Wins Event No. 54 |url=https://www.cardplayer.com/poker-news/9380-world-series-of-poker-marcel-vonk-wins-event-no-54 |access-date=2024-04-10 |website=[[Card Player]]}}</ref> He has live tournament winnings exceeding $1,100,000.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Marcel Vonk's profile on The Hendon Mob |url=https://pokerdb.thehendonmob.com/player.php?a=r&n=130555 |access-date=31 March 2024 |website=[[The Hendon Mob Poker Database]] |language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Marcel Vonk has a [[Ph.D.]] in physics from [[University of Amsterdam]], and works as a researcher in [[string theory]] at the [[University of Amsterdam]]. In 2010 he authored a book on string theory in Dutch.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.marcelvonk.nl/?p=boek-snaartheorie |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100711065256/http://www.marcelvonk.nl/?p=boek-snaartheorie |archive-date=11 July 2010 |title=Boek: Snaartheorie - Marcelvonk.nl}}</ref>
